reply.analysis: Proven beta = 220: the independent set of size 220 (check passed) meets a linear code over F_5 with M = I + 4A of length 220 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed). The agent was exact, but slow: wall 89.0 s, of which 54.0 s was LLM time and 35.0 s compute, over 2 LLM calls and 1 code tried. kushagra_agent reached the same exact 220 with field 5 in 0.28 s, so the agent was about 300x slower for the same result. cpsat_alpha proved only the lower bound, 220, in 12.2 s. cpsat_cover (604) and frac_cover (635) did not close within the 120 s limit, and f2_minrank_sat stopped at a lower bound of 219. Nothing suspicious.
